# FormFlare

> Self-hosted forms and waitlists for any website, deployed to your own Cloudflare account in one click. A website posts to `https://<instance>/f/<publicId>` with no API key; submissions land in the owner's dashboard and trigger email alerts and signed webhooks.

For AI coding agents: the full, tested playbook (embedding in React/Next.js/HTML, waitlists and referrals, error codes, webhook verification, the REST API, deploying and updating) is in the Agent Skill below. In a FormFlare dashboard, every form's Share tab has a "Copy prompt" button with that form's exact endpoint and fields.

## Agent skill

- [skills/formflare/SKILL.md](https://github.com/SeifElkadyy/FormFlare/blob/main/skills/formflare/SKILL.md): how to add FormFlare forms to a website and operate an instance
